sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 8 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You've got to know how to fight with style! If you're packing a heavy caliber, then use it to the fullest. Light them up straight through cover! The crowd loves it when someone turns the place into a bloodbath without all the fancy tricks. Just go in and crush your opponents. Forget about careful aiming! Show everyone what you're capable of."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 50 enemies with point fire while using light machine guns

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +32,000 EXP
- +300 Light Machine Guns skill points
- 30 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
